description.en: Triggered by TodoTrigger when tests/lint/build fail. Diagnoses, attempts a fix, re-tests. Requires a SaaS factory in the project (directory saas-factory/ or FACTORY_ROOT with the CLI tools/factory); it is not part of this repository.
description.de: Wird vom TodoTrigger gefeuert, wenn Tests/Lint/Build fehlschlagen. Diagnostiziert, versucht Fix, testet erneut. Voraussetzung: eine SaaS-Factory im Projekt (Verzeichnis saas-factory/ oder FACTORY_ROOT mit der CLI tools/factory); sie gehört nicht zu diesem Repository.

author: MySuricates
instructions: Run automatically by the TodoTrigger. Hard rules: at most 3 attempts per issue (the trigger controls this), never disable tests, never mask symptoms. When in doubt, abort the fix — the TodoTrigger then escalates to a manual review.

config.command:
set -euo pipefail
echo 'TODO_TITLE={{ todo_title }}'
echo 'TODO_DESCRIPTION={{ todo_description }}'
echo 'TODO_TAGS={{ todo_tags }}'
echo 'PROJECT={{ project_path }}'

You receive the error context of a TODO that the TodoTrigger fired.

CONTEXT:
{{ previous_output }}

TASK — diagnosis:
1. What kind of error? (test-failed | lint-failed | build-failed | type-failed | missing-feature | doc-stale | dependency-vuln)
2. Which specific error? (parse it from tags + description; if needed, read .factory-test-*.log in the project)
3. Possible causes (1-3)
4. Fix strategy (in 1-2 sentences)

Output the diagnosis as JSON:
{
  "error_type": "...",
  "specific_error": "...",
  "likely_causes": ["...", "..."],
  "fix_strategy": "...",
  "confidence": "high|medium|low"
}

If confidence=low: end the diagnosis with "fix_strategy": "ABORT — manual review needed".

config.success_criteria: factory test in the project directory returns JSON with ok=true.
config.goal:
Fix the error based on the diagnosis.

DIAGNOSIS (JSON):
{{ previous_output }}

PROJECT PATH: {{ project_path }}

IF fix_strategy = 'ABORT' → write 'AUTO_FIX_ABORTED — manual review needed' and stop.

OTHERWISE:
1. Implement the fix strategy (as surgically as possible — touch only the problematic spot)
2. Re-run factory test in the project
3. Iterate until ok=true OR the iteration budget is used up
4. If it is still red: write 'AUTO_FIX_FAILED' — the TodoTrigger increments fixAttempts and may escalate

Never disable tests, add .skip() or remove asserts. Never mask symptoms.

config.command:
set -euo pipefail
RESULT={{ previous_output }}
if echo "$RESULT" | grep -qE 'AUTO_FIX_ABORTED|AUTO_FIX_FAILED'; then
  echo 'GATE_RED'
else
  echo 'GATE_GREEN'
fi
